source.name: Escape on a closed dropdown toggle inside a modal must close the modal
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/33465) at 6e7f1a9a347f4cc38a8973044440afa52f2cffcd. Blind to the maintainers' fix f36f8344533d3179b8d82af96e005b3106d9ab46; routing auto.

journey.goal: Escape closes the dialog while focus is on the access button

guards.title: Escape inside the open access menu closes only the menu
guards.goal: The first Escape closes the menu and keeps the dialog open

plan.root_cause: The dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler unconditionally calls event.stopPropagation() for the Escape key, preventing the event from reaching the modal's Escape handler, so the modal does not close when focus is on the dropdown toggle.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify dropdown.js's static dataApiKeydownHandler to stopPropagation only when the dropdown is shown (active). When the dropdown is not shown, allow the Escape event to propagate so ancestors like a modal can handle it.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape key will now close the share dialog when focus is on the access toggle button, satisfying the requirement that Escape dismisses the dialog.
functional_risks: If the dropdown is open, Escape will still close the dropdown and not propagate (due to stopPropagation), preserving existing behavior.

A slight risk exists that stopping propagation only for active dropdowns could interfere with other components that rely on Escape propagating from within a dropdown, but this matches the intended dropdown behavior.
verification_requirements: Open share dialog, focus on Access toggle, press Escape → dialog closes (button not visible).
Open share dialog, open dropdown menu (e.g., press Alt+Down Arrow), press Escape → menu closes but dialog remains open.
Ensure other keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down, Space, Enter) still works as expected.
Ensure modal's Escape closing works when focus is elsewhere in modal (e.g., on Cancel button).
